mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5%, it signals labor market weakness that triggers central bank policy support, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad demand contraction, triggering a short-term equity sell-off as recession risks rise over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing output decline signals reduced corporate capacity utilization and inflationary pressures, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may lead to aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI inflation and federal funds rate (CPIAUCSL > 3.5 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0) indicates active monetary tightening, depressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both CPIAUCSL > 3.5 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 > 18500), strong economic momentum supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 18500, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
